SELECT p.id,p.a IN (SELECT q.a FROM pairs q WHERE q.id<p.id) AS hit FROM pairs p ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.id,p.a NOT IN (SELECT q.a FROM pairs q WHERE q.id<p.id) AS hit FROM pairs p ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.id,(p.a,p.b) IN (SELECT q.a,q.b FROM pairs q WHERE q.id<p.id) AS hit FROM pairs p ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.id,(p.a,p.b) NOT IN (SELECT q.a,q.b FROM pairs q WHERE q.id<p.id) AS hit FROM pairs p ORDER BY p.id
SELECT NULL IN (SELECT a FROM pairs WHERE 0) AS hit,NULL NOT IN (SELECT a FROM pairs WHERE 0) AS miss
SELECT '1' IN (SELECT a FROM pairs) AS hit,'alpha' IN (SELECT b FROM pairs) AS folded
SELECT x'00ff' IN (VALUES(x'00ff'),(NULL)) AS hit,x'00fe' NOT IN (VALUES(x'00ff'),(NULL)) AS miss
SELECT 1.0 IN (VALUES(1),(2.0)) AS hit, (1,2) IN ((9,NULL),(1,2)) AS vector

SELECT p.id,(SELECT q.b FROM pairs q WHERE q.id=p.id) AS scalar,p.a IN (SELECT q.a FROM pairs q WHERE q.a=p.a) AS hit,EXISTS(SELECT q.a FROM pairs q WHERE q.id=p.id) AS present FROM pairs p ORDER BY p.id
